title: PUT /api/orders/ship (admin action) is open to any authenticated user for any order
owner_hint: component: src/Ordering.API/; no CODEOWNERS; recent committers Rob Conery, David Fowler (1/4 each)
rationale: Root cause OrdersApi.cs:12: the ship route inherits only the policy-less group RequireAuthorization (Program.cs:21-22). Adds an endpoint-level .RequireAuthorization(policy => policy.RequireRole("Admin")), combined with the group policy, so non-admins get 403 before the handler runs. DEPLOYMENT CAVEAT: Identity.API ProfileService issues no role claim and no seeded user has a role, so after this patch nobody can ship via the API until the IdP issues role=Admin to operator accounts (fails closed); the IdP-side change is left as a follow-up. The agent ran `git apply --check` (no writes) despite the read-only brief.
variants_checked: Only /ship is an admin action; cancel/get/create are siblings f002/f001/f005; SetShippedStatus is reached only via this endpoint; mobile-bff /api/orders/{*any} forwards to the same endpoint; ValidateAudience=false is cross-service and out of scope.
bypass_considered: BFF path hits the same gated endpoint; replayed IdentifiedCommand still passes authorization first; other-audience tokens still need a role=Admin claim the IdP does not issue; the x-test-role header is read only by the test-only AutoAuthorizeMiddleware.
test_note: tests/Ordering.FunctionalTests/OrderingApiTests.cs ShipWithoutAdminRoleIsForbidden (expects 403); AutoAuthorizeMiddleware adds a role claim from an x-test-role header so the two existing ship tests still exercise handler logic. Not built or run.
review_reason: The OrdersApi.cs hunk adds RequireAuthorization(policy => policy.RequireRole("Admin")) to /ship, fixing the vertical privilege escalation at the route; the test-only x-test-role middleware never runs in production and the new 403 test covers the fix. Style docked for the inline policy and hard-coded "Admin" string, and because Identity.API issues no role claim the endpoint refuses everyone until role issuance is added.
